title: Reports
subtitle: Audit-ready reports generated from committed activity records
subtitleUser: Audit-ready reports generated from committed activity records · {name} ({role})
provenance: Reports are computed from committed activity records using prototype demo emission factors — not authoritative DEFRA/AIB values. Scope 3 is not covered by this inventory.
liveBanner: Live preview — not an issued report. Every figure is read from the database as you look at it and can change; an issued report is retained and downloaded exactly as issued.
withdrawnOne: 1 record was withdrawn from this reporting year. It counts towards no figure above, and every export lists it with the reason recorded at the time.
withdrawnMany: {count} records were withdrawn from this reporting year. They count towards no figure above, and every export lists them with the reason recorded at the time.
draftWarning: {percent}% of this period's records are draft/rejected — this report is not suitable for final reporting.
statusNote: Review status of this selection's records — not an inventory certification. Only a final issued report certifies the inventory.
noCommittedData: No committed data for this selection.
methodology: Methodology: every calculation stores an immutable snapshot of the emission factor it used (value, source, version) — the full factor appendix is included in the generated PDF/Excel. Boundary: operational control. Aligned with ISO 14064-1 / GHG Protocol.
cannotGenerate: Your role can view report data but cannot generate or export reports.
excelNote: Excel contains Summary, Raw Activity Data, Withdrawn Records and Factors Used sheets. Every generation is recorded in the audit log.
sharingNote: Report sharing (link / email) arrives in a later phase.

coverage.heading: Inventory coverage (live)
coverage.noBoundary: No inventory boundary is declared for {year}. Coverage is unknown, so nothing here shows that the inventory is complete.
coverage.notReadable: The {year} inventory boundary declares a subsidiary outside your access, so its coverage is not shown here; an administrator sees it.
coverage.notCovered: Scope 3 is not covered by this inventory, so no boundary applies to this selection.
coverage.tooBroad: This selection holds more records or evidence links than one report reads, so its coverage is not assessed. Narrow it to see its coverage.
coverage.assessed: Boundary version {version} ({decision}): {satisfied} of {total} included obligations satisfied; sources excluded with a reason: {excluded}.
coverage.assessedExtract: Boundary version {version} ({decision}), for this selection: {satisfied} of {total} included obligations satisfied; sources excluded with a reason: {excluded}.
coverage.complete: No coverage gap. This is still not a certification: only a final issued report certifies the inventory.
coverage.nothingIncluded: The boundary includes no emission source for this selection: every category is excluded with its reason.
coverage.outsideBoundary: This subsidiary is outside the {year} inventory boundary: none of its records is covered by it.
coverage.unavailable: The boundary's coverage could not be loaded just now, so it is unknown here — not complete. Reload to try again.

scope3.notCovered: Scope 3 is not covered by this inventory.
scope3.recorded: Committed Scope 3 records outside every figure here: {count} ({tonnes} tCO₂e calculated).
scope3.uncalculated: {count} of them carry no figure yet, so the calculated sum leaves them out.
scope3.noInventoryFigures: Scope 3 is not covered by this inventory, so this selection has no inventory figures. Its committed records are counted above, never summed.

issued.heading: Issued reports for {year}
issued.intro: An issued report is captured from one moment of the inventory boundary and retained: its PDF, workbook and CSV are downloaded as issued, never regenerated.
issued.notForRole: Your role does not read issued reports.
issued.readOnly: Your role reads issued reports; it does not capture or issue them.
issued.loadFailed: The issued reports could not be loaded.
issued.captureNote: Captures the year's newest boundary version as one whole inventory, read at one moment. An open version is frozen first, unconfirmed.
issued.noBoundary: No inventory boundary is declared for {year}, so there is nothing to capture.
issued.consultantOpen: The year's newest boundary version is still open: a super_admin freezes it by capturing it first.
issued.previewPartial: Partial — gaps that block a final report: {count}.
issued.finalForbidden: A final report is issued by a super_admin.
issued.issueIntro: Issues this dataset as a retained PDF. Its status and gaps come from the dataset alone.
issued.truncated: Showing the newest {count}; older issued reports exist.
issued.currentNote: The newest final report you can read.
issued.datasetsTruncated: Showing the newest {count} datasets; older ones exist.
issued.currentOutside: The current final report is older than the reports shown here.

issuanceGap.filtered_extract: A filtered extract, never a final report
issuanceGap.non_authoritative_calculation: Figures not on an authoritative factor release
